# HHLManyBody22.PerturbEstimate

**实际行微扰估计与证书**

构造实际两行微扰估计、非零分母检查与真实查询费用；误差或min/max身份须由真实残差/谱条件导出。

**边界**：PDF p11 Eq24 Algorithm1, FigA2 p22 and FigA5 p27. Shifting repeats need not prevent collisions with other diagonal values or preserve positivity. Printed d_ii plus shifted denominators needs an original-A residual certificate; N-1 terms alone prove no accuracy.

**覆盖等级**：C
